status: confirmed by product owner 2026-09-10; water medium remapped to the low cell 2026-09-11 after the fixed-path recheck; stim_protocol.json mechanics unchanged (dt, w_syn, cell sets, duration, trials, readout)

notes.ir94e: Four levels; the characterization showed high and very_high not distinguishable, so they are merged into 'high' = 200 Hz. Ir94e is not exposed in the v1 encoder; the v1 lookup uses the ir94e = none slice. Included so v2 does not need a second grid run.
notes.water: Five encoder levels are kept, but low and medium share one grid cell (both 60 Hz) because the model cannot separate weak water drives: the fixed-path recheck (docs/fixed_path_recheck.md) found water 60 -> 120 Hz indistinguishable on every curve (alone, and as a modifier at sugar 60/100/200). 60 Hz is visible only as a helper to sugar (sugar x water surface); 180 and 240 Hz drive MN9 alone. The grid runner deduplicates identical Hz vectors, so the grid is 5 x 5 x 4 x 4 = 400 unique cells; lookups resolve level names by Hz.
notes.sugar: 25 Hz gives 0 Hz MN9 in this model, so the former 25/50 levels were replaced; threshold is near 40 Hz, saturation near 90 Hz MN9.
notes.readout: left MN9 (720575940660219265) per stim_protocol.json; right recorded
